title: ENHYPEN, Ella Langley, Stella Lefty & More: Highlights of This Week’s Billboard Charts
summary: All of Billboard’s charts update each Tuesday.
contentText:
Tuesday is new Billboard chart day each week! As all charts update each Tuesday morning, here’s a look at highlights of the latest rankings, dated Sept. 5 and reflecting the Aug. 21-27 measurement week, according to data tracker Luminate.

Among this week’s chart stars are ENHYPEN , Ella Langley, Stella Lefty, Shakira and Burna Boy.

ENHYPEN earns its first No. 1 album on the  Billboard 200  as  THE SIN : BLISS  debuts with 98,000 equivalent album units in the United States in its first week (ending Aug. 27), according to Luminate. It’s also the act’s seventh top 10, all notched consecutively, and its ninth No. 1 on the World Albums chart, dating to its first leader in May 2021.

Related

ENHYPEN Reacts to Old Interviews, Talks New Era, Coachella & Tour Prep | Billboard News

A group of groups: Also notably, multi-member acts have debuted atop the Billboard 200 in each of the past three weeks, as, prior to ENHYPEN, KATSEYE’s WILD premiered the week before, after Stray Kids opened with THIS & THAT. Such a run is rare, as it’s the first three-week streak of groups launching at No. 1 in more than eight years. The last such stretch, in June-July 2018: Dave Matthews Band’s Come Tomorrow , 5 Seconds of Summer’s Youngblood and Panic! at the Disco’s Pray for the Wicked .

Check out more key highlights from this week’s Billboard charts below.

Plus, see how listeners are celebrating Dolly Parton’s music, given her placements on the Hot 100 and on the Billboard 200 following her Aug. 25 passing .
